weight_bank_graph.scope: Independent calls with equal-valued weights at distinct addresses; shared input, metadata, scratch and caches. Retained boundaries belong to the final call. No hidden-state dependency between calls and no TP reduction.

cases.separate_workspace_scope: Explicit front/selector/tail buffers only; excludes stock CANN Prolog/SFA internal workspace and graph allocations.

shadow_cache.scope: Full shadow initialization follows each fixture cache restore outside capture/timing. Each native call updates current INT64 slots during the first front projection; no added phase barrier.

placement_comparison.scope: Four recaptured graphs O(A), P(A), O(B), P(B). Within each arena, ordinary and candidate share scratch, tiling, output and all cache addresses. All graphs share input, weights and metadata. Replays are serialized. Each arm restores the same cache values and warms three graph replays outside its event; timed slot writes are idempotent.
